title: Veromanitra Noëlle RAMIZASON
text:
I am a postdoctoral researcher in BETSAKA project conducted jointly by the Malagasy National Research Center in Developement Economics (CERED) at Antananarivo University and the French National Research Institute for Sustainable Development (IRD), part-time lecturer in Economic Mention in the Faculty of Economic, Gestion and Sociology at Antananarivo University , member of the Doctoral research team (EAD) at the Ecole Doctoral Ecosystèmes Naturels (EDEN) at Mahajanga University
I have a background in applied mathematics and statistics, specializing in actuarial science during my university studies at Aix-Marseille University.
I completed my PhD at Ecole Doctorale Ecosystèmes Naturels in January 2025, under the supervision of Senior Professor Hery Lisy Tiana RANARIJAONA and Senior Professor Heriniaina RAMANANKIERANA.
You can contact me at my email adress.
